findings.title: add() subtracts instead of adding
findings.detail: add(a, b) returns `a - b`, but the issue asks for the sum. For example, add(2, 3) returns -1 instead of 5. The fix is `return a + b`.

findings.title: No tests accompany the change
findings.detail: The repository has only calc.py. There is no test file and no test for add(). Nothing would catch the wrong operator noted above.

definition_of_done.item: The change is covered by tests that fail without it.
definition_of_done.evidence: The working tree contains only calc.py, with no test files (no test_*.py, tests/ directory or similar). Nothing exercises add(), and a correct test would currently fail because add returns a - b.

learnings: The repo has a single file, calc.py, and no test infrastructure.
The add() implementation uses the wrong operator (- instead of +).
